title: Thin with "thick feeling texture," rough, and only mildly absorbent towels and definitely not luxury
text:
Thin with "thick feeling texture," rough, and only mildly absorbent towels and definitely not luxury. These towels are definitely not luxury. They almost remind me of car wash drying towels as they are thin, rough, and only mildly absorbent. The raised texture of the towel is what makes them feel thicker than they are.

Before being washed they measured 27" length by 15-1/2" to 16" width. After washing and drying they are 24" in length by 15" in width give or take a few increments. On the plus side they do not wrinkle and they did not bleed any color.

I got a stain on my white towel and was unable to wash it out. Usually, stains come out with my other towels as I'm only using these to dry the dishes or as added protection when pulling things out of the oven.

Overall, I do not feel these are worth the current price of $12.99. DII brand products vary from very good to poor and to me this is on the poorer side. Attached is a picture of one of the towels when it was brand new to show you how thread is pulling away from the towel. I cut that piece off and it was fine. I will only be using these towels a few times before they get used as rags.

Wash before first use.
